entry.title: BILL047(24) (Honolulu): — → FILE
entry.content:
RELATING TO REAL PROPERTY TAXATION.

Establishes dedications of real property as aina kupuna. Provides petition requirements to qualify for the dedication. Applies to tax years beginning July 1 2026 and thereafter.

Status: — → FILE

Latest action: Filed pursuant to ROH SEC 1-2.4 which sets a two-year filing period on pending bills.
